question: five HUMF receipts in a row closed with the same sentence -- STILL NOT MODELLED, a provider that corrupts CONSISTENTLY IN BOTH DIRECTIONS so every digest agrees with itself. A gap carried five times without being built is a gap nobody has actually looked at.

WHAT_THE_MODE_IS_AND_WHY_IT_IS_NOT_CONTR.shape: the corruption is an INVOLUTION, XOR with a fixed mask, applied on copy_in and undone on copy_out
trace: copy_out()          returns (x ^ m) ^ m == x   -- THE ROUND TRIP AGREES
read_for_compute()  returns x ^ m              -- what a KERNEL sees
WHAT_THE_MODE_IS_AND_WHY_IT_IS_NOT_CONTR.why_this_is_a_real_bridge_failure: a stuck address line, a byte-swapped DMA descriptor or an endianness mismatch in a driver is exactly this: a deterministic transform applied symmetrically. The UN-DOING on read-back is not exotic, it is what makes the fault invisible to every check that goes back over the same transport.

cells.why: it compares x against x; there is nothing for it to see

cells.check: source identity seal, blake2b at registration
cells.why: it protects the SOURCE and the source was never written

cells.check: resident digest through the COMPUTE path
cells.why: the device digests x^m and the fabric wants the digest of x; the transfer RAISES and the destination stays out of valid_copies()

cells.check: resident digest through the READBACK path
cells.why: the digest un-does the corruption exactly as copy_out does, so it reports the source's own digest for memory a kernel would misread

THE_FOUR_CHECKS_AND_THE_PREDICTION_WRITT.verdict: all four confirmed. The gap carried for five receipts is NOT a hole in the fabric -- it is caught by the check the resident-digest block built, and it is open exactly where that block already said its strength lives.

SO_THE_GAP_NARROWS_RATHER_THAN_CLOSING.what_closed: consistent bidirectional corruption is now MODELLED, executable, and caught by a named check rather than listed as unhandled
SO_THE_GAP_NARROWS_RATHER_THAN_CLOSING.what_stays_open_and_why_the_fabric_canno: the catching check reads the device's OWN digest of its OWN memory, and whether that digest reads the compute path or the read-back path is a property of the DEVICE. ReadbackConsistentCorruptionProvider is INDISTINGUISHABLE from an honest one through the API: it offers digest_resident, it answers, its digest matches the source, resident_verified comes back True. The fabric records resident_digest_path as a CLAIM and does not trust it, and that record is the entire defence.
SO_THE_GAP_NARROWS_RATHER_THAN_CLOSING.the_shape_of_the_remaining_risk: not an unconditional hole any more but a QUESTION SOMEBODY CAN ASK A VENDOR -- does your device digest kernel read the same memory path your compute kernels read -- which is a different and far better position than a gap with no name.

tests.anti_vacuity_first: a test asserts the provider's ROUND TRIP agrees AND its compute path does not, because if the stored bytes were fine the whole block would test nothing
tests.the_honest_control: an unmodified provider still transfers CLEAN through the same path with resident_digest_path 'compute' -- a check that only ever refuses is as useless as one that only ever accepts
mutations_watched_failing: copy_out no longer undoes the corruption -> the mode becomes visible to the round-trip check and the readback test fails
the resident digest is never taken -> the compute-path catch disappears and the honest control loses its recorded path
the readback control digests the compute path instead -> it starts catching the corruption and stops being a control

claim_boundary: MOCK PROVIDER ONLY. No external GPU exists, every transport number in HUMF is a knob, and S015 §21 forbids citing one as physical evidence. What is proven is the STATE MACHINE and THE SCOPE OF EACH CHECK, not any hardware property.
the corruption is INJECTED, not observed. Nothing here says how likely a symmetric transport fault is, only what each check does when one occurs.
ONE corruption shape -- a byte-wise involution. A transform that is NOT an involution would break the round trip and be caught trivially; one that is stateful or position-dependent is untested.

STILL NOT MODELLED and unchanged: an adversary who can observe the sealed identity or recompute a crc32, and TRUST DECAY beyond the existing identity_recheck_age -- the resident check runs ON TRANSFER, so a scrub afterwards still needs audit().
nothing timed; no kernel changed; no performance claim moves.
